away.summary: The Sabres (8-7-3) are coming off an 8-3 loss to Tampa Bay and did not hold a morning skate. Goalie Alex Lyon is expected to join the team on its six-game road trip but is not yet confirmed to start; Colten Ellis is listed first in the projected lineup. Jiri Kulich and Zach Metsa are scratched, while Louis Crevier could play against his former team after being a healthy scratch for three straight games.

doubtful.detail: hopeful to probable to return after missing three games

home.summary: The Blackhawks (4-13-1) held an optional morning skate. Patrick Kane is "hopeful to probable" to return after missing three games with an upper-body injury. Spencer Knight is listed first in the projected goalie rotation, with Drew Commesso recalled from Rockford after Arvid Soderblom was waived and assigned to the AHL.
